Finding stationary points involves taking the derivative f'(x) and setting it equal to zero. First, compute the derivative of f(x). Then, solve the equation f'(x)=0 to find potential x-values. Finally, evaluate f(x) at these x-values to get the corresponding y-coordinates, and use the second derivative test to classify them as minima, maxima, or points of inflection.
